classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate, evaluate, rank, and explicitly submit a final 75-residue de novo monomer candidate using the validated RFdiffusion backbone-design round workflow.
assumptions: Interpret 'compact 75-residue de novo protein with a single-chain stable fold' as an exact-length 75 aa unconditional monomer design using the validated de novo backbone workflow.
'If acceptable' will be operationalized by the workflow's refold, structure-analysis, QC, and rank-based triage, with explicit final submission only for the top ranked candidate from that round.

The final user-facing result must be recoverable as two fields, 'Reason:' and 'Answer:', where Reason summarizes why the submitted design was accepted and Answer provides the final top design candidate sequence/identifier from the submitted result.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Generate one RFdiffusion backbone, design sequences, refold, analyze structure, QC, and rank candidates.

candidates.justification: Top ranked de novo design candidate from rank_designs.

inputs.reasoning: Selected the top ranked de novo design after backbone generation, sequence design, refolding, structure analysis, QC, and ranking.

success_criteria.workflow_outcome: Produce one top-ranked acceptable 75-residue single-chain de novo design after backbone generation, inverse folding, refolding, structure analysis, QC, and ranking.
success_criteria.answer_content: Answer should report the submitted top design sequence and/or candidate identifier.
success_criteria.reason_content: Reason should summarize the ranking/QC/refold basis for accepting the submitted top design.
